name: With a two-piece washable rug: Tumble's Canyon Grey/Ivory 8x10 from Amazon, pad included, across the room under the LISABO and its chairs
notes: Andrew, 2026-10-26 (night): "I think we need something like a ruggable so that it's thin enough and separate from the padding to allow actually washing." Layout L with the two-piece system in place of IKEA's one-piece LOKALTÅG: Tumble's Canyon Grey/Ivory 8x10 ($399, cushioned pad included), spillproof face, washable at home. Same footprint across the room, x 8 to 128, y 23 to 119 (rot 90): the table and both chair rows on it pushed back, 7" into the living-room walkway and 22" into the kitchen's, which a rug may do (F-42). Color (F-68): a cool gray ground gives the pale ash LISABO its contrast and matches the gray seats; ivory motifs keep it light on the oak. Ruggable's flatwoven Cambria Abalone 8x10 is $579 with its pad; Tumble's Canyon Oatmeal/Grey is the warmer alternative. The staged A stays rugless until Eutine chooses. Andrew, later that night: "tumble rug is orderable on amazon! pretty convenient we should prefer that unless ruggable is way better or something": the rug placed is the Amazon listing amazon-B0HCMZMMD5 ($399, ships in 4 to 5 days, free delivery November 9, as read 2026-10-26), the same set at the same price; Ruggable's flatwoven is judged not clearly better (thinner cover, $180 more per 8x10, made to order, the same robot-vacuum caveat), so Tumble it is (F-69).
